annotations.title: Add a watermark to a PDF

description: Add a text such as “CONFIDENTIAL” or “Copy for the bank” to every page of your PDFs, diagonally or repeated, in the colour and strength you want. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

layout.description: Layout Values: 'diagonal' = Diagonal; 'horizontal' = Horizontal; 'mosaico' = Repeated across the page

name: watermark_pdf
title: Add a watermark to a PDF
